create_atoms_dataset_sequence: create an AtomsDatasetSequence from an AseAtomsDataset to iterate over atoms objects
index_atoms_dataset_sequence: index an AtomsDatasetSequence with an integer to retrieve a single Atoms object
get_atoms_sequence_length: get the length of an AtomsDatasetSequence to find the total number of atoms
review_atoms_sequence_protocol: review the AtomsSequence Protocol to understand the interface for Atoms indexing and length
refactor_atoms_dataset_sequence: refactor AtomsDatasetSequence to support slice indexing instead of raising IndexError
